description_en: Retrieves the run logs for a JMeter test. By default, this operation queries the logs from machine 0 and returns the total number of machines
description_zh: 获得JMeter运行日志。默认查询第0台机器的日志，并返回机器总数
kebab_example: aliyun pts get-jmeter-logs --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --report-id KS2YE3J2 --begin-time 1637115306000 --end-time 1637115309000 --agent-index 0 --level INFO --thread main --keyword test --api-version 2020-10-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetJMeterLogs

parameters.help_en: The number of the page to return
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return on each page
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The start time. This value is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds
parameters.name: begin_time

parameters.help_en: The end time. This value is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en: If you specify an invalid index, the logs of engine 0 are returned
parameters.help_zh: 非法Index直接返回第0台引擎的日志
parameters.name: agent_index

parameters.help_en:
The log level. Valid values:

ERROR
WARN
INFO: The default value.
DEBUG
TRACE
parameters.help_zh:
日志等级。包括：

ERROR：错误
WARN：警告
INFO：信息，默认值
DEBUG：调试
TRACE：跟踪
parameters.name: level

parameters.help_en: The keyword to search for in the logs
parameters.name: keyword
